name: Kami no Rhapsody
source:
The great plains of Kvarna spreads out from the border between the western part and the central plains of the Raulbash continent. This was the territory of the demi-humans who have resided here peacefully for thousands of years.

One time, the ‘Kami no Kaido’, the ruler of the southeastern plains who is close to God, declared that he would train a successor to inherit his immense power and knowledge. With those words, he opened the gates to the holy land, ‘Shrine of the End’ (Tsui no Goshi). The successor candidates were bestowed the privilege to explore the previously-sealed area and various abilities by the Kami no Kaido, to overcome the severe trials that lay before them.

Youths from all races and religions heeded this call and gathered together, including the young researcher Erballade who left his hometown to seek wisdom and the unknown. There will only be one successor. With honour, wisdom, power and wealth, along with the expectations of their hometowns, a fierce competition is about to begin.


[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/04/01/april-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
拉烏爾巴什大陸西部與中央平原交界處，延伸著廣闊的卡瓦納大平原。半人類在此和平生活了數千年。

某日，接近神明、統治東南平原的「神之戒土」宣布要培養繼承者，傳承自己龐大的力量與知識。隨著這句話，他開啟了聖地「終之御子」的大門。候選繼承者獲得神之戒土賜予的探索封印區域與多種能力的特權，以克服前方嚴酷的試煉。

各個種族與宗教的年輕人響應召集，聚集於此，其中包括離開故鄉、追求智慧與未知的年輕研究者埃爾巴拉德。繼承者只有一人。榮譽、智慧、力量與財富，以及故鄉的期待，一場激烈競爭即將開始。

［譯自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/04/01/april-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
